questions.question: Discuss the negative impact of AI.
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the Negative Impact of AI
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) has many advantages, but it also creates several negative impacts
  • on society.
  • Job Displacement – Automation may replace human workers in industries, leading to
  • unemployment.
  • Privacy Concerns – AI systems collect large amounts of personal data, increasing the risk of
  • surveillance and misuse.
  • Bias and Discrimination – AI algorithms may reflect social biases and produce unfair
  • decisions.
  • Cybercrime and Misuse – AI can be used for hacking, deepfakes, and spreading
  • misinformation.
  • Dependence on Technology – Excessive reliance on AI may reduce human creativity and
  • decision-making abilities.
  • Ethical Issues – Lack of accountability in AI decisions raises moral and legal concerns.
  • Therefore, responsible use and regulation of AI are essential for protecting society.
questions.final_answer: Therefore, responsible use and regulation of AI are essential for protecting society.

questions.question: How does identity theft occur in the digital world, and what can individuals do to safeguard their personal information?
questions.solution_html:
• How does Identity Theft Occur in the Digital World, and What can Individuals do to
  • Safeguard their Personal Information?
  • Identity theft occurs when criminals steal personal information such as passwords, bank
  • details, Aadhaar numbers, or social media credentials for fraudulent purposes.
  • Common Methods:
  • Phishing emails and fake websites
  • Hacking and malware attacks
  • Data breaches
  • Social engineering techniques
  • Safeguarding Measures:
  • Use strong and unique passwords.
  • Enable two-factor authentication.
  • Avoid sharing sensitive information online.
  • Update software and antivirus systems regularly.
  • Be cautious while opening suspicious emails or links.
  • Use secure websites for online transactions.
  • Digital awareness and cyber security practices help protect individuals from identity theft.
questions.final_answer: Digital awareness and cyber security practices help protect individuals from identity theft.
